findings.title: rework_signature keeps verify.log's volatile `prestate:`/`pre_*` headers, so an identical failure reads as new
a stale capture is served as "the previous attempt's failure" on rework rounds that captured nothing
`task retry` and `task unblock` still delete the verify log without capturing it first
rework.md takes all remaining truncatable budget, starving lessons.md and context.md on every rework attempt
